correctness.rationale: Starting from the published Fourier-mode characteristic equation, the half-sum/half-difference factorization gives \(\omega=2\sqrt{K_pK_n}\sin s\) and reconstructs both delay branches reversibly. For equal delays the scalar equation gives the displayed first crossing; implicit differentiation gives a positive crossing speed, and the stated modal ordering follows from monotonicity of the closed expression. The no-open-neutral-phase statement follows from the analytic switching curves plus standard retarded-DDE spectral continuity.
residual_risks: The compact script is only a numerical example; it is not the proof of the all-parameter formulas.
